title: Scars of Mirrodin: card flavor text

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane of five suns where Phyrexia's influence spreads.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial realm whose influence seeps into Mirrodin and whose agents seek to convert it.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A ruler whose reign and war machines are remembered; the Mirran elders vanished with him.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: The lost leader of the leonin.

entities.name: Kemba, Kha Regent
entities.description: The regent kha of the leonin, who says she is not Raksha.

entities.name: Ghalma the Shaper
entities.description: A loxodon artificer who speaks of will and necessity.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker called to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who speaks of blessings and the flesh.

entities.name: Sheoldred, Whispering One
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who preaches rebirth into Phyrexia.

entities.name: Geth, Lord of the Vault
entities.description: A lord who stokes Phyrexia's fires at Ish Sah and scorns the Moriok.

entities.name: Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who preaches the remaking of the world.

entities.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who wishes to unite the flesh.

entities.name: Urabrask the Hidden
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who speaks of the Glorious Word.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroys abominations with slag.

entities.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
entities.description: An elf outlaw with a vedalken bounty on his head.

entities.name: Thrun, the last troll
entities.description: The last troll, who speaks of ignominy and walls.

entities.name: Krol
entities.description: A goblin furnace-priest.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A Neurok agent.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: A Neurok agent.

entities.name: Lafarius
entities.description: A Neurok sky agent.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: A vedalken emisar.

entities.name: Yavash
entities.description: A member of the Accorders.

entities.name: Ranya
entities.description: A skyhunter captain.

entities.name: Ganedor
entities.description: A loxodon mystic.

entities.name: Lephar
entities.description: A loxodon surgeon.

entities.name: Adaran
entities.description: A Tangle hunter.

entities.name: Konnos
entities.description: A Sylvok sage.

entities.name: Tarrin
entities.description: A Hammer-Tribe shaman.

entities.name: Juryan
entities.description: A rebel whose followers are in the Cave of Light region.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose journal is mentioned.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: A people of Bladehold who forge their own weapons.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A vedalken faction in a power struggle with others.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: A people who spread necrogen and revere nim.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: A people of druids and lifestaffs.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A people who see the artificer as a catalyst.

entities.name: Accorders
entities.description: An Auriok order who never strike first but always strike back.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people split into two prides after losing Raksha.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A scholarly people who research the Phyrexian contagion.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves of Tel-Jilad who purged troll influence.

entities.name: Blade Tribe
entities.description: A tribe whose warriors charged a golem.

entities.name: Bladehold
entities.description: An Auriok stronghold with a rogues' gallery of living statues.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A swamp of necrogen spreading over the Tangle and the Quicksilver Sea.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: A metallic forest overrun by the Mephidross.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A silver sea bordered by the Razor Fields.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: A plain of Whitesun celebrated by the Auriok.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: A place at whose heart Geth stokes Phyrexia's fires.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A goblin region with subterranean furnaces.

events.summary: The Mirran elders vanish with Memnarch, leaving a generation of wayward orphans.
events.quote: The Mirran elders vanished with Memnarch

events.summary: The leonin lose their leader Raksha and split into two prides, one supporting the regent kha and one rebelling.
events.quote: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides

events.summary: The shadow of the Mephidross spreads over the Tangle and the vampires' territory expands.
events.quote: As the shadow of the Mephidross spread over the Tangle, the vampires' territory expanded.

events.summary: Warriors of the Blade Tribe charge a golem, twenty strong, and return ten and a half.
events.quote: The warriors of the Blade Tribe charged the golem, twenty strong.

events.summary: Geth stokes the dark fires of Phyrexia at the heart of Ish Sah.
events.quote: At the heart of Ish Sah, Geth stokes the dark fires of Phyrexia.

events.summary: The vedalken and Neurok struggle for power, and many casualties simply disappear.
events.quote: Most casualties of the power struggle between vedalken and Neurok didn't die on the field of battle

relations.note: Regent kha supported by one pride.
relations.quote: one side supported the regent kha

relations.note: The vedalken put a record bounty on him.
relations.quote: commands the highest bounty the vedalken have ever placed upon an outlaw
